_comment: WDM dungeon-map patches. Hosted from Trimitor's own releases rather than copied into this repo: 66 MB of binaries would bloat git history permanently, and upstream is the legitimate distribution point. Tags are pinned so a new upstream release cannot change what players get without us deciding to move.
The -N archive only ships in beta tags upstream; it is the optional Caverns and Mines (microdungeons) expansion.

Mount pack v1: mount models backported from Cata 4.3.4 + MoP 5.4.8 into 3.3.5a (1353 displays / 183 new models), plus patched CreatureModelData.dbc + CreatureDisplayInfo.dbc. Hosted from this repo's own releases, not committed to payload/, to keep ~290 MB of binaries out of git history -- same rationale as the WDM patches above. Tag is pinned so re-releasing under a new tag is a deliberate act.

Client DBC patch (mounts-v4): the consolidated client DBC bundle. (1) Spell.dbc -- all client-side spell edits (GCD tuning etc., formerly payload patch-enUS-Z) + the 565 mount spells (850000-850564) for patch-Q, with the Red Mastiff (850139) at +15% speed. (2) AreaTable.dbc -- clears NO_FLY_ZONE on the 15 Dalaran subareas (restores Dalaran flying, lost when payload patch-Z was retired) and sets AREA_FLAG_OUTLAND on all Eastern Kingdoms + Kalimdor areas. (3) Map.dbc -- maps 0/1 ExpansionID -> 1 so the client permits flight in the old world. Replaces the old payload patch-enUS-Z (which sorted after patch-R and shadowed the mounts). Server loads a matching AreaTable.dbc from its data volume and has the Dalaran restricted-flight spell_area (58600) removed.
